modules.name: TheReelPeet
modules.description: Dual generative sequencer with probabilistic note holds and drops, per-lane Rise/Fall envelope, and Dynamics knob for evolving melodic motion.

modules.name: TheReelPeet-Evo
modules.description: Single-lane genetic-algorithm sequencer. Evolves patterns via elitism, crossover, and mutation (Drift/Persist) instead of flat randomization, for repetition-with-change generative melodies.
